rationale: Piecewise-linear IEEE-style Volt-VAR curve with breakpoints at the sag (0.94 pu) and swell (1.07 pu) timesteps. q_fraction at those voltages is set to the minimum reactive injection and absorption that brings corrected voltage to the 0.95 and 1.05 pu limits via the published linear sensitivity, minimizing total |Q| while keeping Q within sqrt(kVA^2-kW^2).
